note: Eight interleaved pairs on one host, alternating which runtime ran first. The parent shares every key with Bytes::slice. The candidate copies keys of at most 24 bytes into the record and still shares the value. Every run verified 20,000 records, including the 16-byte synth key, and validation_failures stayed 0. Allocation count fell from 629 to 359 on every run. Before median 595,377.63 records/s, after median 627,525.69. Paired mean ratio 1.061, bootstrap 95% CI 0.996 to 1.149. The interval includes 1, so this is not claimed on the wall-clock route. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record mean ratio was 0.941. Two of eight pairs were slower. Not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
